thread:
maya: kicking off a short soak in staging for per-org / per-key rate limiting. generator running for ~60m with variable qps ramps. please watch the quota dashboards, datadog logs, and the new quota.events stream. tagging @eng-platform for visibility.

luis: what traffic generator are you using? share config?

maya: using loady (our internal lib) + a small locust wrapper — config gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/loady-staging-burst-split

ops-bot: :rocket: soak job started: job_id=soak-1770001110, runner=loady-staging-3

jordan: quick question on policy: is burst implemented as a token_bucket with explicit burst_tokens, or are we doing permissive negative balance?

maya: token_bucket. config for the run: token_rate=50/s, burst_tokens=100 (so ~2s of burst at full rate). per-key enforcement enabled, per-org override allowed.

anika: seeing some odd logs already — a few keys appear to sustain bursts longer than expected. snippet: 

```
[2026-03-17T15:03:21Z] key=org_123 reqs=120 window=12s outcome=allow token_balance=-30 pod=staging-rt-4
[2026-03-17T15:03:23Z] key=org_123 reqs=30 window=2s outcome=throttle token_balance=-5 pod=staging-rt-7
```

anika: note the pod mismatch, looks like token balance went negative on pod-4 then another pod evaluated later and throttled.

sam: that points to lack of sticky routing or stale in-memory counters on pod hops. when we shard bucket state in memory and route without affinity, refill math breaks.

luis: agree. also telemetry: quota.events metric doesn't include rate_limit_reason tag (burst vs steady vs quota). makes postmortem hard.

jordan: internal API semantics debate: currently our gateway sometimes returns 200 + {error: 'throttled'} for certain internal flows. I think we should standardize on 429 + Retry-After header for any hard throttle. easier for clients and correct for HTTP semantics.

luis: careful — several internal clients expect 200 and parse body. immediate change will break things. maybe feature-flag the header behavior per org: X-RateLimit-Mode: strict|compat.

maya: prioritize fixes for staging: 1) telemetry/enrichment: add rate_limit_reason tag, token_replenish_latency histogram, and dashboard panels + alert (P0) 2) routing affinity (sticky by org hash) for burst windows (P1) 3) API semantics change behind org-level feature flag (P2).

anika: I'll open the telemetry PR first — will add tags to quota.events, expose histogram for token_replenish_latency, and a small dashboard tile. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/telemetry/pulls/867

ops-bot: CI pipeline kicked: telemetry/pr-867 · tests=ok · build=passed · artifacts: https://ci.redwood/telemetry/867/artifacts

sam: for sticky routing, rolling plan: canary to a small subset of pods + per-org flag to enable. need to validate cross-pod latency and failure scenarios (pod drain). also watch leak of tokens when pods restart.

jordan: about headers — here's a minimal curl showing the desired response for strict mode:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-RateLimit-Mode: strict" https://api.staging.redwood/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "rate_limited", "reason": "burst" }
```

luis: for compat mode we keep 200 body + warning header for a deprecation window. we should document this in the console rollout UX so enterprise customers can opt in.

maya: canary rollout plan for telemetry + sticky routing: telemetry deploy to all staging nodes today, dashboard + alert in the morning. sticky routing behind feature flag, enable for 10 orgs in staging, monitor for 1h, then bump to 50 orgs. sam, you okay with that?

sam: yep. I'll create the canary feature toggle and a small runbook. adding probes: check for increased 429 churn and token_balance skews.

anika: opened telemetry PR and added a sample datadog dashboard snippet in the PR description. tagging eng-platform, telemetry, and product-observability. :mag: PR link above.

luis: also adding a new metric: quota.gate.rejected.count with tag reason=burst|steady|quota so alerts can be specific.

maya: add a short alert: WHEN sum:quota.gate.rejected.count{reason:burst} / sum:requests.total > 0.005 for 1m THEN page oncall. threshold tentative.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: ff:staging/sticky-routing · id=ff-5503 · target=0%

anika: I'll own the telemetry rollout. sam will own sticky routing rollout. jordan/luis — can we get an API UX doc for the header compat plan?

jordan: will draft a short doc and console UX notes, link to it in #docs.

maya: thanks all. ping here with any anomalies. :thumbsup:

luis: ack.

sam: ack.

anika: ack and starting PR review.
